answer: Calibration-gated seats: before an identity earns, it must grade 6 answers per epoch, 2 of them hidden mirror items, reworded copies of already-settled answers. A seat qualifies only if it lands within one point of the settled grade on both mirrors, judged against an ivory set of 200 expert-labelled answers. Each item costs about 4 minutes of real reasoning, so 500 fakes burn roughly 200 compute-hours per epoch, paid even if never caught. Unqualified seats wait in a harbor queue that admits 10 per epoch.
